as_told.title: Buck slip from Harrington congratulating Brent

plain: A television writer named Brent Friedman says that in 1996, while working on Dark Skies, a TV series about a hidden UFO story, he got a buck slip, a short office note, from John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy. Friedman says the note read: "Hey Brent, you finally got your story out there. Congratulations." He tells it as his own experience, and in one telling he places it the week before a show he calls Sound, Light and Frequency premiered. The suggestion is that a senior official was hinting that the story was true.
